# Exact Sciences

[Woman relaxing at sunset.]
Introducing

## Cancerguard^{®}

Our innovative multi-cancer early detection test.
We're united by a shared purpose: helping people live fuller lives through better health. Together,
we will transform the way cancer is detected, diagnosed and managed for more people around the
world.
[Exact Sciences is now ABBOTT.]
[Lab technician examining a test sample on a microscope slide.]
We’re fighting cancer every step of the way
[A smiling patient hugging a caregiver.]
So that everyone feels confident about their path forward

## ## We help bring clarity to cancer

Cancer creates so many uncertainties. We’re committed to answering questions, solving problems, and
making a lasting, positive impact on people's lives. Our tests explore hereditary risks, screen for
cancer’s presence, and examine the unique genomic alterations of an individual’s cancer after a
diagnosis to help guide their treatment.

## Everything starts with people

We’re focused on patients, providers, doctors, researchers, and caregivers. Our medical experts
partner with the industry’s best minds and collaborate with top institutions, advocacy partners, and
policymakers to help change lives and transform how the world approaches cancer.
[A woman named Deepa smiling.]

## A breast cancer surgeon's breast cancer journey

Hear how genomic testing helped Deepa and her doctor make an informed decision to forgo
chemotherapy.^{[*][15]}
[oncotype DX Breast Recurrence Score logo.]
[A woman named Leigh Anne smiling.]

## Convenient testing made early detection easy

Watch how testing at home helped Leigh Anne take the first step in diagnosing and treating her colon
cancer before it progressed.
[Cologuard by Exact Sciences logo.]
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Fueling breakthroughs in cancer care

Our experience and process set us apart. Life-changing science. Deep expertise. Strong
collaboration. State-of-the-art labs. Rigorous research. The result? Proven accuracy, better
potential outcomes, and continuous progress in the fight against cancer.
[Two Exact Sciences technicians working with lab equipment.]

## Putting big ideas into action

Discover our DNA through our latest announcements and stories.
[Colorectal cancer survivors uniting at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences.]

## The Power in Numbers

Colorectal cancer survivors unite at the Cologuard Classic by Exact Sciences to celebrate their
triumphs, build community

## Become part of something meaningful

Changing lives and achieving our purpose starts with our team and their commitment to fighting
cancer. Are you ready to make a difference? Explore open positions and learn why Exact Sciences has
been a certified Great Place To Work^{®} for seven years running
[Three Exact Sciences' associates collaborating in the Wisconsin headquarters' atrium.]
[An Exact Sciences associate writing on a white board while her colleagues look on.]
[An Exact Sciences customer representative smiling and talking on a phone headset.]

## Get in touch

Questions or comments? Find customer support, company contacts, and location information all in one
place.

## Footnotes
1. In addition to being an Oncotype DX^{®} Ambassador, Deepa occasionally serves in a professional
   capacity as a paid consultant of Exact Sciences. These services are unrelated to this activity.
1. Diergaarde B, Young G, Hall DW, et al. Circulating tumor DNA as a marker of recurrence risk in
   stage III colorectal cancer: the α-CORRECT study. *J Surg Oncol*. Jan 2025. (Suppl). doi:
   10.1002/jso.27989

Our innovative multi-cancer early detection test.

world.

[A smiling patient hugging a caregiver.]

## ## We help bring clarity to cancer

Cancer creates so many uncertainties. We’re committed to answering questions, solving problems, and
making a lasting, positive impact on people's lives. Our tests explore hereditary risks, screen for
cancer’s presence, and examine the unique genomic alterations of an individual’s cancer after a
diagnosis to help guide their treatment.

## Everything starts with people

We’re focused on patients, providers, doctors, researchers, and caregivers. Our medical experts
partner with the industry’s best minds and collaborate with top institutions, advocacy partners, and
policymakers to help change lives and transform how the world approaches cancer.
[A woman named Deepa smiling.]

chemotherapy.^{[*][15]}

# Bringing the future of genetic testing within reach

Together, Invitae (“in-VEE-tay”) and Labcorp make it easier to access genetic data, uncover personal
health insights and deliver the right care for each patient's needs.

## Make genetic testing part of your routine healthcare

[Invitae and Labcorp]

## More personalized care starts here

Invitae and Labcorp have come together to help deliver more breakthroughs for more patients.

[More about us][1]
[Female holding child patient – Invitae genetic testing]

## Meaningful insights

We're always looking to support you with our dedicated genetic testing services and tools. Let our
genetic counselors help you translate results into potential next steps.

[Male patient in blue long sleeve shirt – Invitae genetic testing]

## Expanded access

With coverage by most health plans and Labcorp's nationwide network of conveniently located patient
service centers, genetic testing is more accessible for more patients.

[ Female patient in blue blouse – Invitae genetic testing]

## Trusted expertise

Together with Labcorp, we’re leaders in advancing genetic testing and treatments. We help you gain a
more complete picture of your health.

[Choosen by 5+ million patients and their providers - Invitae genetic testing]

## Chosen by 5+ million patients and their providers
* ### Let's get started
  
  Contact us to learn more about how we can meet your genetic testing needs.
  
  [Get in touch][2]

## Have questions?
* [{{showUpText}}]
  Now that Invitae is a part of Labcorp, what should I know?
  
  Working together helps us deliver on our mission to improve health and improve lives. With
  coverage by most health plans and Labcorp's nationwide network of conveniently located patient
  service centers, we're working to make innovative genetic testing more accessible. Our combined
  industry leadership will continue to advance the field of genetics while improving patient care
  and access. [Learn more][3]
* [{{showUpText}}]
  How are Invitae’s genetic tests different from other genetic tests?
  
  Invitae’s broad test offerings inform every stage of life for patients and their families,
  providing a single, reliable source for genetic testing. Flexible billing options and built-in
  support enable more clinicians and patients to make confident health decisions based on results.
  Explore tests in [Invitae’s test catalog][4].
* [{{showUpText}}]
  Are genetic counseling services available to all patients undergoing Invitae testing?
  
  A genetic counseling session is available to answer questions about genetic testing and results.
  This is included at no additional cost to patients located in the US, US territories, and Canada
  who have ordered a currently offered Invitae genetic test. Learn more on [this genetic counseling
  page][5].
* [{{showUpText}}]
  Who can I contact today?
  
  To speak directly with client services, email [clientservices@invitae.com][6] at any time or call
  [800-436-3037][7] Monday through Friday, 5:00 am to 5:00 pm Pacific time. Visit our [contact
  page][8] to find more information.

[Invitae]

Our mission is to improve health and improve lives.

  providing a single, reliable source for genetic testing. Flexible billing options and built-in
  support enable more clinicians and patients to make confident health decisions based on results.
  Explore tests in [Invitae’s test catalog][4].
* [{{showUpText}}]
  Are genetic counseling services available to all patients undergoing Invitae testing?
  
  A genetic counseling session is available to answer questions about genetic testing and results.
  This is included at no additional cost to patients located in the US, US territories, and Canada
  who have ordered a currently offered Invitae genetic test. Learn more on [this genetic counseling
  page][5].
* [{{showUpText}}]
  Who can I contact today?
  
  To speak directly with client services, email [clientservices@invitae.com][6] at any time or call
  [800-436-3037][7] Monday through Friday, 5:00 am to 5:00 pm Pacific time. Visit our [contact
  page][8] to find more information.

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care.

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]
[Labcorp biopharma technician evaluating samples]

Labcorp OnDemand

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

[ Shop All Tests ][223]

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

## In the spotlight

[Roche publishes its first quarter results for 2026][103]

Roche reports 7% (CER) sales for the full year results in 2025. Commenting on the results, CEO
Thomas Schinecker said: “2025 was a strong year for Roche, reflecting our continued focus on
operational and R&D excellence.”

[How we improved outcomes for patients around the world][104]

With our combined strengths in Diagnostic and Pharmaceuticals, we worked to provide real and
positive change for patients, the people they love and the professionals who care for them. Discover
the highlights in our Annual Report.

people can live healthier, longer lives.

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

# Dedicated Digestive Care

We care about your GI health and improving your quality of life! We partner with you to provide
high-quality and compassionate care.

[About Us][21]

# Colonoscopies Save Lives

If you are nearing the age of 45, it's time to discuss a simple procedure that can help in the fight
against colon cancer—a colonoscopy.

[More Information][22]

# Feeling The Burn Of Acid Reflux?

If acid reflux and heartburn occur more than twice a week, this may indicate that GERD is present.
Is your acid reflux pain something more?

[Find Out More][23]

## About Cary Gastroenterology

### Cary Gastroenterology is the premier private GI practice in the area, providing digestive care
### to the Cary, Raleigh, Holly Springs and Triangle region for the past 30 years.

Our seven physicians are Board-Certified in Gastroenterology and Hepatology, with the knowledge and
expertise to treat all digestive disorders. As a patient, you are always personally evaluated and
treated by your physician at your visit, and a physician is available 24 hours a day, seven days a
week to address your digestive needs.

[Why Choose Us?][24]

## Women's Center

At the Women's Center for GI Health, our mission is to improve the health and longevity of women's
lives through dedicated digestive care.

[Visit the Women's Center][25]

## Hemorrhoid Center

We strive to not let hemorrhoids hold you back. Our mission is to help you learn about your
condition and to get you on your way to relief.

[Visit the Hemorrhoid Center][26]

To help you prepare for your visit or procedure, we've provided many of our important forms and
instructions online for your convenience.

* Hands-on Teaching
* Personalized Coaching

THE STORY BEHIND THE TEST

## Backed by science, powered by technology^{13,14}

Cologuard Plus helps find colon cancer in its early stages, when it is more treatable.

[A microcospic image of cells.]

### Gathering cells to uncover your body’s natural clues
* Polyps are small, usually harmless growths in the colon
* Left undetected, they can develop into cancer over time
* These polyps can shed cells or leave behind microscopic amounts of blood in the stool that become
  clues to detecting cancer

[Illustration of a DNA strand.]

### Advanced technology for targeted analysis
* Using exclusive technology, your stool sample goes through a purification process in our lab
* Cologuard Plus uses a precise biomarker panel to detect 4 distinct DNA markers (signs of DNA
  damage) and tiny blood traces, focusing on key mutations linked to colon cancer
* This multi-marker approach can detect cancer early, even before symptoms appear or become serious

[Illustration of a biomarker test panel with a syringe releasing a blood specimen.]

### Clear and actionable results within 8 to 10 days
* Abnormal DNA or blood findings are weighted for a more accurate prediction of your risk for colon
  cancer
* A positive result may mean a higher-than-average risk of precancerous polyps or colon cancer,
  while a negative result suggests a lower-than-average risk

HOW TO GET THE COLOGUARD PLUS TEST

## Two easy ways, one smart choice

[A couple doing research using a laptop in a home setting.]

### Request online

Answer a few questions, and one of our telehealth providers can prescribe Cologuard Plus for you.

[Get started][65]
[A doctor in consultation with a patient in a hospital setting.]

### Talk with your provider

Your health care provider can prescribe Cologuard Plus at any time. Our discussion guide makes
starting those conversations easy.

[Get discussion guide][66]

If you’ve discussed Cologuard Plus with your health care provider in the past and believe it may
have been ordered for you, please call Exact Sciences Laboratories at 1-844-870-8870.

Telehealth may be offered by your health care provider.

Telehealth providers may charge a fee for their services associated with the consultation.
Telehealth providers operate independently from Exact Sciences and Exact Sciences Laboratories. Only
orders from licensed health care providers are accepted.

## You’ve got questions,
## we’ve got answers

[Explore All FAQs][67]

### Who is the Cologuard Plus test for?

Cologuard Plus is for adults 45 years of age and older who are at average risk for colon cancer. It
is not a replacement for colonoscopy in high-risk individuals.

### How does the Cologuard Plus test work?

Cologuard Plus uses advanced stool technology to detect DNA and blood cells released from altered
cells. It can detect both colon cancer and precancer.

[Learn more][68]

### How effective is the Cologuard Plus test?

In a study that included a subset of nearly 19,000 average-risk patients aged 45-86, Cologuard Plus
detected 95% of Stage I to IV colon cancers. In a subset of 20 adults aged 45-59, Cologuard Plus
detected 100% of all colon cancers.¹
1. Cologuard Plus^{®} Clinician Brochure. Madison, WI: Exact Sciences Corporation.

[Learn more][69]

### How do I get the Cologuard Plus test?

If you’re 45+ and at average risk for colon cancer, there are two easy ways to request Cologuard
Plus: online or through your health care provider. Either way, we’ll deliver your prescribed kit
right to your door.

## Backed by science, powered by technology^{13,14}

Cologuard Plus helps find colon cancer in its early stages, when it is more treatable.

[A microcospic image of cells.]

### Gathering cells to uncover your body’s natural clues
* Polyps are small, usually harmless growths in the colon
* Left undetected, they can develop into cancer over time
* These polyps can shed cells or leave behind microscopic amounts of blood in the stool that become
  clues to detecting cancer

[Illustration of a DNA strand.]

### Advanced technology for targeted analysis
* Using exclusive technology, your stool sample goes through a purification process in our lab
* Cologuard Plus uses a precise biomarker panel to detect 4 distinct DNA markers (signs of DNA
  damage) and tiny blood traces, focusing on key mutations linked to colon cancer
* This multi-marker approach can detect cancer early, even before symptoms appear or become serious

[Illustration of a biomarker test panel with a syringe releasing a blood specimen.]

### Clear and actionable results within 8 to 10 days
* Abnormal DNA or blood findings are weighted for a more accurate prediction of your risk for colon
  cancer
* A positive result may mean a higher-than-average risk of precancerous polyps or colon cancer,
  while a negative result suggests a lower-than-average risk

[When to get screened][92]

### Family History

When it comes to understanding your risk for certain types of cancer, knowing your family history
can be incredibly valuable. Collecting this information isn’t as daunting as it may seem – it’s
simple as having a conversation with your loved ones.

[Family History][93]

## Get Involved

#### Raise awareness and support those affected by colorectal cancer in your community.

### Get Your Rear in Gear

Our 5K Run/Walk events bring local communities together to raise colon cancer awareness, support
patients/survivors and caregivers, remember those we’ve lost, advocate for early detection through
screening, and fundraise for education and screening.

[Join The Movement][94]

### Spokes Spin-off series

Challenge yourself and your community to to ride, raise awareness, and funds to end colon cancer.
All bike types. All distances. All fitness levels. Set your goal and ride!

[Start a Ride][95]

### Fundraise Your Way

Join our year-round fundraising initiative where YOU can join the movement to encourage screening,
educate your community, and support patients and survivors, no matter where you are or when you’re
ready to join in.

[Get Started][96]

## The Heart of Our Mission

#### Hearing you have colon cancer can make you feel lost, but that doesn’t mean you are. Learn how
#### others reclaimed their power and voice and explore our collection of resources.

# We are the largest nonprofit dedicated to colorectal cancer

[AllyCon patients, caregivers, and staff group photo at AllyCon 2025]

# Patients, families, friends, and caregivers united as allies

[Three Allies at AllyCon 2024 excited to be there]

# Voices of hope, shoulders to lean on, arms open wide

[Family at Walk to End Colon Cancer with medals]

# Breaking new ground, busting old stigmas

[Woman in lab working]

# We're here for you, and for each other

[man and woman hugging]
Pause

## We will end colorectal cancer, together

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance is fiercely determined to end colon and rectal cancers within our
lifetime. Together with a nation of passionate allies, we advocate for prevention, magnify support,
and accelerate research to stop this disease. Your contribution helps bring us closer to a world
free from colorectal cancer.

[Donate Now][147]
[The things you hear Vicki]Play

## Your colorectal cancer ally

Find resources for patients, survivors, caregivers, and family members.

[Seth Tabor man in hospital providing thumbs up]

### Colorectal cancer basics

Colorectal cancer is a cancer that starts in the colon or rectum, which are parts of the digestive
system. Unlike most cancers, colorectal cancer is often preventable with screening and highly
treatable when detected early.

[What is colorectal cancer?][148]
[Three people with poop emoji at an event]

### Screening and prevention

The best way to prevent colorectal cancer is getting screened on time. Screenings can also find
cancer early when treatment is most effective. Most people should begin colorectal cancer screenings
at age 45, but people with certain risk factors may need to start screening earlier.

[Take the screening quiz][149]
[Woman ringing cancer bell at hospital]

### Treating colorectal cancer

Colorectal cancer is highly treatable if caught early. There are many types of treatments for
colorectal cancer, including surgery, chemo, radiation, and other therapies. Your treatment
typically depends on the location of the cancer and the stage of diagnosis.

[Newly diagnosed? Start here][150]
[Volunteers at event]

### Get help and support

A colorectal cancer diagnosis can be a challenging time. It helps to know that resources, support,
and information are always available. A nation of allies is standing by ready to help you navigate
your path to survivorship.

[Access resources][151]

## Updates

[The Project Cure CRC and KLEOS adaptive clinical trial platform logos over a white and blue
gradient background.]

### [Alliance and GCAR Announce Collaboration to Advance a Groundbreaking Adaptive Clinical Trial
### Platform for CRC: KLEOS][152]

A first-of-its-kind trial platform in the colorectal cancer space, Project Cure CRC’s KLEOS is being
driven by the Colorectal Cancer Alliance, the leading nonprofit dedicated to ending the disease, in
collaboration with GCAR, a pioneer in the design and implementation of innovative clinical trials.

Last updated May 29, 2026
[The Alliance and Screen Smart logos. ]

### [Alliance Breaks Down New ACS Screening Guidelines][153]

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance is urging Americans to prioritize colorectal cancer screening, as the
American Cancer Society (ACS) released updated guidelines today.

Last updated May 27, 2026
[An image announcing that the Alliance has won a Webby award for LEAD FROM BEHIND]

### [LEAD FROM BEHIND Honored with Prestigious Webby Award][154]

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance LEAD FROM BEHIND initiative featuring Katie Couric is a winner in the
30th Annual Webby Awards.

Last updated Apr 21, 2026

## I was diagnosed with stage-I colon cancer. Due to my cancer’s localized nature, it was relatively
## simple to treat. Had I ignored my doctor’s plea and waited to get screened, I could have been
## facing full-blown metastatic disease in just a few years, which is much harder to overcome.

La Donya Reed
Survivor

## How will you help end colorectal cancer?

With your support, we can end colorectal cancer in our lifetime. There are so many ways to take
action!

[Get involved ][155]
[Craig Melvin and Lindsay Czarniak at the National Bash]

### [ Attend an event ][156]

We host events across the U.S. dedicated to raising awareness and funds to combat colorectal cancer.
When you participate in one of our events, you'll help make a meaningful difference in the mission
against this devastating disease.

[man leads runners at the leslie grace 5k]

### [ Start a fundraiser ][157]

End Colon Cancer Coast to Coast empowers you to turn your passion—whether it's golf, running, or any
hobby—into a meaningful fundraiser to help end colorectal cancer. Get the resources you need and
start your fundraiser today!

[Woman at table advocate event]

### [ Become an advocate ][158]

The movement to end colorectal cancer begins with you. We can help you raise your voice. Our Allies
in Action grassroots advocacy program provides the tools and opportunities to make change in your
own community, state, and beyond.

## Donate to end colorectal cancer in our lifetime

Every dollar you give increases access to screening, provides invaluable patient and family
assistance, and helps to fund critical research.

[Donate now][159]

You don't have to do this alone. **Call our helpline: **[**(877) 422-2030**][160]

# We are the largest nonprofit dedicated to colorectal cancer

[AllyCon patients, caregivers, and staff group photo at AllyCon 2025]

# Patients, families, friends, and caregivers united as allies

[Three Allies at AllyCon 2024 excited to be there]

# Voices of hope, shoulders to lean on, arms open wide

[Family at Walk to End Colon Cancer with medals]

# Breaking new ground, busting old stigmas

[Woman in lab working]

# We're here for you, and for each other

[man and woman hugging]
Pause

## We will end colorectal cancer, together

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance is fiercely determined to end colon and rectal cancers within our
lifetime. Together with a nation of passionate allies, we advocate for prevention, magnify support,
and accelerate research to stop this disease. Your contribution helps bring us closer to a world
free from colorectal cancer.

[Donate Now][147]
[The things you hear Vicki]Play

## Your colorectal cancer ally

Find resources for patients, survivors, caregivers, and family members.

[Seth Tabor man in hospital providing thumbs up]

### Colorectal cancer basics

Colorectal cancer is a cancer that starts in the colon or rectum, which are parts of the digestive
system. Unlike most cancers, colorectal cancer is often preventable with screening and highly
treatable when detected early.

[What is colorectal cancer?][148]
[Three people with poop emoji at an event]

### Screening and prevention

The best way to prevent colorectal cancer is getting screened on time. Screenings can also find
cancer early when treatment is most effective. Most people should begin colorectal cancer screenings
at age 45, but people with certain risk factors may need to start screening earlier.

[Take the screening quiz][149]
[Woman ringing cancer bell at hospital]

### Treating colorectal cancer

Colorectal cancer is highly treatable if caught early. There are many types of treatments for
colorectal cancer, including surgery, chemo, radiation, and other therapies. Your treatment
typically depends on the location of the cancer and the stage of diagnosis.

[Newly diagnosed? Start here][150]
[Volunteers at event]

### Get help and support

A colorectal cancer diagnosis can be a challenging time. It helps to know that resources, support,
and information are always available. A nation of allies is standing by ready to help you navigate
your path to survivorship.

[Access resources][151]

## Updates

[The Project Cure CRC and KLEOS adaptive clinical trial platform logos over a white and blue
gradient background.]

### [Alliance and GCAR Announce Collaboration to Advance a Groundbreaking Adaptive Clinical Trial
### Platform for CRC: KLEOS][152]

A first-of-its-kind trial platform in the colorectal cancer space, Project Cure CRC’s KLEOS is being
driven by the Colorectal Cancer Alliance, the leading nonprofit dedicated to ending the disease, in
collaboration with GCAR, a pioneer in the design and implementation of innovative clinical trials.

Last updated May 29, 2026
[The Alliance and Screen Smart logos. ]

### [Alliance Breaks Down New ACS Screening Guidelines][153]

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance is urging Americans to prioritize colorectal cancer screening, as the
American Cancer Society (ACS) released updated guidelines today.

Last updated May 27, 2026
[An image announcing that the Alliance has won a Webby award for LEAD FROM BEHIND]

### [LEAD FROM BEHIND Honored with Prestigious Webby Award][154]

The Colorectal Cancer Alliance LEAD FROM BEHIND initiative featuring Katie Couric is a winner in the
30th Annual Webby Awards.

Last updated Apr 21, 2026

## I was diagnosed with stage-I colon cancer. Due to my cancer’s localized nature, it was relatively
## simple to treat. Had I ignored my doctor’s plea and waited to get screened, I could have been
## facing full-blown metastatic disease in just a few years, which is much harder to overcome.

La Donya Reed
Survivor

## How will you help end colorectal cancer?

With your support, we can end colorectal cancer in our lifetime. There are so many ways to take
action!

[Get involved ][155]
[Craig Melvin and Lindsay Czarniak at the National Bash]

### [ Attend an event ][156]

We host events across the U.S. dedicated to raising awareness and funds to combat colorectal cancer.
When you participate in one of our events, you'll help make a meaningful difference in the mission
against this devastating disease.

[man leads runners at the leslie grace 5k]

### [ Start a fundraiser ][157]

End Colon Cancer Coast to Coast empowers you to turn your passion—whether it's golf, running, or any
hobby—into a meaningful fundraiser to help end colorectal cancer. Get the resources you need and
start your fundraiser today!

[Woman at table advocate event]

### [ Become an advocate ][158]

The movement to end colorectal cancer begins with you. We can help you raise your voice. Our Allies
in Action grassroots advocacy program provides the tools and opportunities to make change in your
own community, state, and beyond.

## Donate to end colorectal cancer in our lifetime

Every dollar you give increases access to screening, provides invaluable patient and family
assistance, and helps to fund critical research.

[Donate now][159]

You don't have to do this alone. **Call our helpline: **[**(877) 422-2030**][160]

Primary Menu

How has Crucial Catch’s focus on cancer screening and prevention impacted your life?

[Share your story][9]

The NFL’s Crucial Catch mission is to fight cancer through early detection and risk reduction. The
league, its clubs, players, the NFL Players Association and the American Cancer Society are
committed to providing individuals with the tools they need to help them better understand early
detection and ways to reduce their cancer risk. Each year, every NFL team raises awareness during
their Crucial Catch game, which features on-field and in-stadium Crucial Catch elements. Crucial
Catch games also present a special opportunity to honor cancer survivors and those currently
battling cancer.

[Crucial Catch Impact][10]
[Crucial Catch Impact][11]
[CHANGE Grant Health Centers Map][12]
[NFL Crucial Catch | American Cancer Society]
[Striped bar]

# CANCER SCREENING SAVES LIVES.

[Presented by Novartis]
[Striped bar]

Some cancers can be found early, before they have had a chance to grow and spread. The 5-year
survival rate for many cancers is over 90% when detected early. Getting screened is crucial to
catching cancer early when it may be easier to treat. Make your play and find your local cancer
screening center^{*}.

* Search results are for convenience only.  Inclusion of a healthcare professional or organization
in any of these databases or results does not imply endorsement by the American Cancer Society

## **Find Your Local Screening Center**^{*}

[What screening do I need?][13]

[Presented by Novartis]
[The Defender | Sleep Number]

# MAKE A CRUCIAL CATCH.

There’s no sure way to prevent cancer, but you can go on offense with regular screening and
lifestyle changes to help reduce your risk. Take the quiz to learn more about what screening tests
and lifestyle choices are right for you.

[Take the Quiz][14]
[Demario Davis, New Orleans Saints Linebacker and Ambassador for the American Cancer Society]Demario
Davis, New Orleans Saints Linebacker and Ambassador for the American Cancer Society
Photo: AP Images
[Four people wearing NFL team gear posing in a photo frame for Crucial Catch]

## START THE CLOCK AND SCHEDULE YOUR SCREENING REMINDER.

Get text, email, and calendar reminders to find and schedule a screening appointment.

[Schedule Now][15]
[Striped bar]

# CARE AND HOPE ARE ALWAYS ON CALL.

Need more information on screening? Have you been diagnosed with cancer? Our live chat and helpline
are here to help.

### [800.227.2345][16]

Call our 24/7 cancer helpline

### [LIVE CHAT][17]

Use our live chat M-F, 8 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET.

[Striped bar]

## **ADDITIONAL RESOURCES**.

#### **STAY SAFE IN THE SUN**

More time in the sun means keeping your skin protected from the harsh rays. Skin cancer is the most
common form of cancer in the U.S., but it’s also very treatable when caught early. Take our sun
safety quiz below to test your knowledge and stay safe during the NFL season and outside at all
times!

[Take the Sun Safety Quiz][18]
[Information Icon]

#### **HAVE YOU BEEN DIAGNOSED WITH CANCER?**

A cancer diagnosis impacts many parts of your life, both physically and emotionally. Learn how to
prepare for treatment and adjust to life with cancer.

[Learn How to Live Well With Cancer][19]
[Sleep Icon]

#### **THE IMPACT OF SLEEP**

The American Cancer Society and Sleep Number have formed a long-term partnership to embark upon
foundational sleep research, informing the first-ever sleep guidelines for cancer. Check out the
Sleep Study to see why it’s important to identify the impacts of sleep quality.

[Read About the Study][20]
[Percent Icon]

#### **EARLY DETECTION SURVIVAL RATES**

Early detection can make a big difference in survival rates. Five-year survival rates show what
percentage of people are still alive five years after they were diagnosed. This information will
help you understand how likely treatment is to be successful if caught early.

[See Survival Rates for Common Cancers][21]

This season’s cause marketing campaign, Man Out of the Arena, underscores the NFL family’s ongoing
commitment to making a meaningful impact beyond the field. It spotlights the character, leadership,
and influence of players as they work together to inspire, connect, and uplift communities. The
campaign aims to demonstrate how collective actions off the field reflect the league’s values, while
serving as a powerful force for unity and positive change.

[Striped bar]

[[NFL Crucial Catch | American Cancer Society]][8]
Primary Menu

How has Crucial Catch’s focus on cancer screening and prevention impacted your life?

[Share your story][9]

The NFL’s Crucial Catch mission is to fight cancer through early detection and risk reduction. The
league, its clubs, players, the NFL Players Association and the American Cancer Society are
committed to providing individuals with the tools they need to help them better understand early
detection and ways to reduce their cancer risk. Each year, every NFL team raises awareness during
their Crucial Catch game, which features on-field and in-stadium Crucial Catch elements. Crucial
Catch games also present a special opportunity to honor cancer survivors and those currently
battling cancer.

[Crucial Catch Impact][10]
[Crucial Catch Impact][11]
[CHANGE Grant Health Centers Map][12]
[NFL Crucial Catch | American Cancer Society]
[Striped bar]

# CANCER SCREENING SAVES LIVES.

[Presented by Novartis]
[Striped bar]

Some cancers can be found early, before they have had a chance to grow and spread. The 5-year
survival rate for many cancers is over 90% when detected early. Getting screened is crucial to
catching cancer early when it may be easier to treat. Make your play and find your local cancer
screening center^{*}.

* Search results are for convenience only.  Inclusion of a healthcare professional or organization
in any of these databases or results does not imply endorsement by the American Cancer Society

## **Find Your Local Screening Center**^{*}

[What screening do I need?][13]

[Presented by Novartis]
[The Defender | Sleep Number]

# MAKE A CRUCIAL CATCH.

There’s no sure way to prevent cancer, but you can go on offense with regular screening and
lifestyle changes to help reduce your risk. Take the quiz to learn more about what screening tests
and lifestyle choices are right for you.

[Take the Quiz][14]
[Demario Davis, New Orleans Saints Linebacker and Ambassador for the American Cancer Society]Demario
Davis, New Orleans Saints Linebacker and Ambassador for the American Cancer Society
Photo: AP Images
[Four people wearing NFL team gear posing in a photo frame for Crucial Catch]

## START THE CLOCK AND SCHEDULE YOUR SCREENING REMINDER.

Get text, email, and calendar reminders to find and schedule a screening appointment.

[Schedule Now][15]
[Striped bar]

# CARE AND HOPE ARE ALWAYS ON CALL.

Need more information on screening? Have you been diagnosed with cancer? Our live chat and helpline
are here to help.

### [800.227.2345][16]

Call our 24/7 cancer helpline

### [LIVE CHAT][17]

Use our live chat M-F, 8 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET.

[Striped bar]

## **ADDITIONAL RESOURCES**.

#### **STAY SAFE IN THE SUN**

More time in the sun means keeping your skin protected from the harsh rays. Skin cancer is the most
common form of cancer in the U.S., but it’s also very treatable when caught early. Take our sun
safety quiz below to test your knowledge and stay safe during the NFL season and outside at all
times!

[Take the Sun Safety Quiz][18]
[Information Icon]

#### **HAVE YOU BEEN DIAGNOSED WITH CANCER?**

A cancer diagnosis impacts many parts of your life, both physically and emotionally. Learn how to
prepare for treatment and adjust to life with cancer.

[Learn How to Live Well With Cancer][19]
[Sleep Icon]

#### **THE IMPACT OF SLEEP**

The American Cancer Society and Sleep Number have formed a long-term partnership to embark upon
foundational sleep research, informing the first-ever sleep guidelines for cancer. Check out the
Sleep Study to see why it’s important to identify the impacts of sleep quality.

[Read About the Study][20]
[Percent Icon]

#### **EARLY DETECTION SURVIVAL RATES**

Early detection can make a big difference in survival rates. Five-year survival rates show what
percentage of people are still alive five years after they were diagnosed. This information will
help you understand how likely treatment is to be successful if caught early.

[See Survival Rates for Common Cancers][21]

This season’s cause marketing campaign, Man Out of the Arena, underscores the NFL family’s ongoing
commitment to making a meaningful impact beyond the field. It spotlights the character, leadership,
and influence of players as they work together to inspire, connect, and uplift communities. The
campaign aims to demonstrate how collective actions off the field reflect the league’s values, while
serving as a powerful force for unity and positive change.

[Striped bar]

# **ADDITIONAL CRUCIAL CATCH LINKS**.

### XNA Technology

Current genomics technology has improved a lot. We can now detect genetic/somatic mutations in
tissue samples (biopsy) and even in body fluids (liquid biopsy). Still, it is tough to find rare
genetic changes, especially those in early-stage cancer or residual cancer cells (MRD, or Molecular
Residual Disease, monitoring).

XNA technology solves this problem by boosting sensitivity and specificity in traditional platforms
like Sanger sequencing, qPCR, ddPCR, and NGS, without changing the existing protocol.

[LEARN MORE ][124]

High-throughput and sensitive mutation detection and quantification capability without DNA
sequencing

### isobDNA™ Technology

Tools like qPCR and ddPCR are often used to quantify gene copy number and gene expression. But, to
get accurate results, we first need to extract and purify the DNA or RNA from samples. The problem
is, during the extraction, we will lose some DNA or RNA. This becomes a big concern when we only
have a small amount of samples to start with.

isobDNA™ technology solves the problem because it does require the sample extraction process.
Instead of amplifying the targets like PCR technology, isobDNA technology amplifies the signals.
It’s just as sensitive as PCR but more accurate.

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission across oncology, worldwide.

[ESMO Guidelines Opens in new window][80]

# Transforming Gastrointestinal Health

Geneoscopy is passionate about the work we do, committed to excellence and believes that
improvements in personalized medicine can impact the lives of patients with gastrointestinal
diseases.

[Learn more][23]

## Our Mission

To empower patients and healthcare providers to transform gastrointestinal health with our
innovative tests that help prevent, detect, and monitor disease.

Enabled by molecular technologies that have led to new disease biology insights, precision medicine
has become the standard of care in some areas of medicine, especially oncology. As a result, there
is a great need to bring this approach to gastrointestinal disease management. A new generation of
noninvasive, molecular-based colorectal cancer screening tests is being developed to enable the
prevention and early detection of colorectal cancer. Meanwhile, the clinical community is beginning
to embrace the value of diagnostics in diagnosing and managing GI diseases, such as ulcerative
colitis and Crohn’s disease. With its innovative stool-derived eukaryotic RNA (seRNA) technology
platform, Geneoscopy is at the forefront of these exciting frontiers to make the screening for
colorectal cancer and other GI diseases safe, effective, convenient, and accessible.

### Our Story

[Explore][24]

### Our Science

[Explore][25]

### Our Progress

[Explore][26]

### Our Future

[Explore][27]

## Our Continued commitment to early cancer detection

Since the beginning, our founders have been committed to bridging the gap in colorectal cancer
screening rates.

Due primarily to the inconvenience and invasive nature of colonoscopies, over 40% of eligible
patients fail to get screened. Despite being very preventable, colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second
deadliest cancer in the US, causing over 50,000 deaths each year.¹

Geneoscopy’s noninvasive stool-based solution can reduce the barriers to screening and help address
the gap in health equity.

## Amit Bhalla, MBA

###### Chief Financial Officer

Amit Bhalla brings over 25 years of experience in the healthcare industry to his role as Chief
Financial Officer at Geneoscopy. Most recently, he served as Executive Vice President and Chief
Financial Officer of Sampled (formerly Infinity BiologiX), a global biorepository that supports
academia, government, and biopharma, where he led all aspects of finance operations as well as
supply chain and facilities functions. Amit also held the position of Vice President of Global
Strategy & Development and was a member of the Executive Management Committee at Becton Dickinson.

On Wall Street, Amit was the lead healthcare analyst for Lord Abbett’s Value Funds, Director of
Equity Research at Citi, and Vice President at Morgan Stanley, where he served as the senior analyst
responsible for overseeing the Life Science Tools, Diagnostics, and Medical Device industries. His
work has frequently been quoted in major financial publications, and he was consistently ranked
among the top analysts on Wall Street by Forbes, Institutional Investor, and Starmine/Financial
Times. Amit earned his Bachelor of Science degree in Neurobiology from Cornell University and an MBA
from Carnegie Mellon’s Tepper School of Business.

early detection test. Before Harbinger Health, he was Vice President of Commercial Oncology at

diagnostics service business, following Hologic’s acquisition of Biotheranos

Financial Officer of Sampled (formerly Infinity BiologiX), a global biorepository that supports
academia, government, and biopharma, where he led all aspects of finance operations as well as
supply chain and facilities functions. Amit also held the position of Vice President of Global
Strategy & Development and was a member of the Executive Management Committee at Becton Dickinson.

On Wall Street, Amit was the lead healthcare analyst for Lord Abbett’s Value Funds, Director of
Equity Research at Citi, and Vice President at Morgan Stanley, where he served as the senior analyst
responsible for overseeing the Life Science Tools, Diagnostics, and Medical Device industries. His
work has frequently been quoted in major financial publications, and he was consistently ranked
among the top analysts on Wall Street by Forbes, Institutional Investor, and Starmine/Financial
Times. Amit earned his Bachelor of Science degree in Neurobiology from Cornell University and an MBA
from Carnegie Mellon’s Tepper School of Business.

## Matt Sargent, MS, MBA

###### Chief Commercial Officer

Matt Sargent, Chief Commercial Officer, brings 20 years of experience leading high-performance
commercial teams in the oncology space. Most recently, he served as Chief Business Officer at
Harbinger Health, responsible for business development related to the company’s blood-based cancer
early detection test. Before Harbinger Health, he was Vice President of Commercial Oncology at
Hologic, responsible for sales, commercial strategy, and business development for the CLIA oncology
diagnostics service business, following Hologic’s acquisition of Biotheranostics, where he served as
Chief Commercial Officer. Matt holds a B.S. degree in Anatomy and Animal Physiology from Cornell
University, an M.S. degree in Cancer Physiology from the University of Buffalo, Roswell Park Cancer
Institute Graduate Division, and an M.B.A. degree from Pepperdine University.

## Andrew Barnell, MBA

###### Chief Executive Officer & Co-founder

Co-founder of Geneoscopy, Andrew graduated from Cornell University with a Bachelor’s degree in
Applied Economics & Management and a specialization in Finance. He received an MBA in Health Care
Management and Entrepreneurial Management from The Wharton School.

Andrew began his career as a financial analyst in J.P. Morgan’s healthcare investment banking group,
working primarily on M&A and capital markets transactions. Andrew also worked as an associate at
Lindsay Goldberg, a middle-market private equity firm focused on partnering with family-owned
businesses.

## Erica Barnell, MD, PhD

###### Chief Medical & Science Officer, Co-founder

Dr. Erica Barnell is the co-founder and Chief Medical & Science Officer of Geneoscopy. She earned
her MD/PhD at Washington University School of Medicine in 2023, completing her doctoral work in
Molecular Genetics and Genomics from the McDonnell Genome Institute. Dr. Barnell spearheaded the
clinical and regulatory development of ColoSense®, Geneoscopy’s flagship diagnostic, and the first
FDA-approved RNA-based stool test for colorectal cancer screening in adults aged 45 and older.

Her work extends beyond colorectal cancer, advancing the application of non-invasive stool RNA
technology to monitor disease activity and predict therapeutic response in inflammatory bowel
disease. A recognized leader in precision medicine and an advocate for health equity, Dr. Barnell
holds multiple patents and has authored numerous peer-reviewed publications. She was named to
Forbes’ 30 Under 30 in 2020, and is a frequent speaker on innovation, leadership, and championing
women in STEM.

## Gary Gallimore

###### Chief Technology and Information Officer

Gary Gallimore, Chief Technology and Information Officer, is a seasoned technology executive with
more than 25 years of experience leading high-performing engineering and IT organizations across the
semiconductor, telecommunications, and healthcare industries. He also serves as Chief Security
Officer, overseeing enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy and ensuring compliance with regulatory
requirements and industry standards.

Most recently, Gary served as Senior Director of Software Engineering at Genomic Health, an Exact
Sciences company, where he led engineering efforts supporting research and product development for
the Oncotype DX Breast Cancer assay, a leading molecular diagnostic test. He brings a strong
combination of strategic vision and business acumen, with deep expertise in in vitro diagnostics
(IVD), laboratory-developed tests (LDTs), and medical device development.

Throughout his career, Gary has held multiple engineering leadership roles with responsibility for
product innovation, operational excellence, and successful commercialization initiatives. He holds a
Bachelor of Science in Electronic Engineering Technology from DeVry University and has pursued
additional studies at the University of California, Santa Cruz; the University of California,
Berkeley; and Santa Clara University.

# Transforming Gastrointestinal Health

Geneoscopy is passionate about the work we do, committed to excellence and believes that
improvements in personalized medicine can impact the lives of patients with gastrointestinal
diseases.

[Learn more][23]

## Our Mission

To empower patients and healthcare providers to transform gastrointestinal health with our
innovative tests that help prevent, detect, and monitor disease.

Enabled by molecular technologies that have led to new disease biology insights, precision medicine
has become the standard of care in some areas of medicine, especially oncology. As a result, there
is a great need to bring this approach to gastrointestinal disease management. A new generation of
noninvasive, molecular-based colorectal cancer screening tests is being developed to enable the
prevention and early detection of colorectal cancer. Meanwhile, the clinical community is beginning
to embrace the value of diagnostics in diagnosing and managing GI diseases, such as ulcerative
colitis and Crohn’s disease. With its innovative stool-derived eukaryotic RNA (seRNA) technology
platform, Geneoscopy is at the forefront of these exciting frontiers to make the screening for
colorectal cancer and other GI diseases safe, effective, convenient, and accessible.

### Our Story

[Explore][24]

### Our Science

[Explore][25]

### Our Progress

[Explore][26]

### Our Future

[Explore][27]

## Our Continued commitment to early cancer detection

Since the beginning, our founders have been committed to bridging the gap in colorectal cancer
screening rates.

Due primarily to the inconvenience and invasive nature of colonoscopies, over 40% of eligible
patients fail to get screened. Despite being very preventable, colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second
deadliest cancer in the US, causing over 50,000 deaths each year.¹

Geneoscopy’s noninvasive stool-based solution can reduce the barriers to screening and help address
the gap in health equity.

## The Galleri^{®} Test

### A multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test

Capable of screening for cancers before they become symptomatic, including those that don’t have
recommended screening tests today.

The Galleri test does not detect a signal for all cancers and not all cancers can be detected in the
blood. False positive and false negative results do occur.

[ Learn more ][54]
[mced blood test vial]
[grail scientist]

## Recent News

#### Galleri^{®} Multi-Cancer Early Detection Blood Test to Employer Plans ][55]

July 16, 2026

June 25, 2026

#### Galleri^{®} Test Substantially Increased Cancer Detection With Robust Performance and Favorable
#### Safety at 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting ][57]

May 31, 2026

## “There's nothing in my family history that had me concerned for cancer...”

Kevin, a healthy firefighter of 30 years, took a multi-cancer early detection test offered by his
fire department. Watch his inspring story.

[ Full story ][58]
[mced laboratory]

## The Science Behind Multi-Cancer Early Detection

### A new approach to screening for cancer

Multi-cancer early detection (MCED) represents a new frontier in cancer screening—using a simple
blood test to identify signals from more than 50 types of cancer, including those without existing
routine screening options.

[ Learn more ][59]
[cancer signal podcast logo]

On this podcast, we explore the stories behind multi-cancer early detection—from patients to
doctors, researchers to advocates, and more.

## OUR MISSION  

# Detect cancer early,
# when it can be cured.

[ About GRAIL ][50]
[

##### NEWS CENTER

][51] [

##### PATIENT STORIES

][52] [

##### CLINICAL EVIDENCE

][53]

## The Galleri^{®} Test

### A multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test

Capable of screening for cancers before they become symptomatic, including those that don’t have
recommended screening tests today.

The Galleri test does not detect a signal for all cancers and not all cancers can be detected in the
blood. False positive and false negative results do occur.

[ Learn more ][54]
[mced blood test vial]
[grail scientist]

## Recent News

#### [ Priority Health Collaborates With GRAIL as the First Michigan Health Plan to Offer the
#### Galleri^{®} Multi-Cancer Early Detection Blood Test to Employer Plans ][55]

July 16, 2026

#### [ GRAIL Completes $110 Million Equity Financing With Samsung Entities ][56]

June 25, 2026

#### [ GRAIL Presents PATHFINDER 2 Results of More Than 35,000 Participants Showing the
#### Galleri^{®} Test Substantially Increased Cancer Detection With Robust Performance and Favorable
#### Safety at 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting ][57]

May 31, 2026

## “There's nothing in my family history that had me concerned for cancer...”

Kevin, a healthy firefighter of 30 years, took a multi-cancer early detection test offered by his
fire department. Watch his inspring story.

[ Full story ][58]
[mced laboratory]

## The Science Behind Multi-Cancer Early Detection

### A new approach to screening for cancer

Multi-cancer early detection (MCED) represents a new frontier in cancer screening—using a simple
blood test to identify signals from more than 50 types of cancer, including those without existing
routine screening options.

[ Learn more ][59]
[cancer signal podcast logo]

### The Cancer SIGNAL Podcast

On this podcast, we explore the stories behind multi-cancer early detection—from patients to
doctors, researchers to advocates, and more.

[ Listen now ][60]
[email newsletter icon]

# **Conquering Cancer
# With Data**

Through the power of blood tests, we can uncover clues that allow doctors to discover cancer early
and find the best way to treat it.

[Explore Our Approach][58]
[ Scroll Down ][59]
Our Solutions

## Blood Is at the Center of **Transforming Cancer Care**

With over 1,000,000 of our blood tests performed by 12,000 doctors to date, our commercially
available tests help inform treatment decisions for patients by holding insights that can improve
clinical outcomes.

[ SCREENING

Learn More

[ ONCOLOGY

Learn More

][61]
[ ONCOLOGY

Learn More

## Delivering on the
## **Promise for Patients**

Precision oncology is redefining cancer care by driving a more personalized and data-driven approach
that improves on traditional standards of care. From using biomarkers to inform treatment in
advanced cancer, to using circulating tumor DNA to not only assess response to treatment, but detect
signs of remaining cancer and even identify the earliest signs of cancer, precision oncology is
helping patients across all stages of the disease.

[Our Commitment to Patients][63]

At Guardant Health, every team member plays a vital role in a mission that impacts countless lives:
conquering cancer through data. We are driven by a commitment to patients through the power of blood
and the life-changing information it holds. We’re looking for curious, talented minds across diverse
fields to take on some of the greatest challenges in human health.

# **Conquering Cancer
# With Data**

Through the power of blood tests, we can uncover clues that allow doctors to discover cancer early
and find the best way to treat it.

[Explore Our Approach][58]
[ Scroll Down ][59]
Our Solutions

## Blood Is at the Center of **Transforming Cancer Care**

With over 1,000,000 of our blood tests performed by 12,000 doctors to date, our commercially
available tests help inform treatment decisions for patients by holding insights that can improve
clinical outcomes.

## Delivering on the
## **Promise for Patients**

Precision oncology is redefining cancer care by driving a more personalized and data-driven approach
that improves on traditional standards of care. From using biomarkers to inform treatment in
advanced cancer, to using circulating tumor DNA to not only assess response to treatment, but detect
signs of remaining cancer and even identify the earliest signs of cancer, precision oncology is
helping patients across all stages of the disease.

[Our Commitment to Patients][63]

scheduling, including Saturday appointments, we make high-quality imaging accessible and

KamaLama is based only on robust science powered by AI
Integrating global health datasets, research libraries, and AI models to identify the strongest
evidence-based predictors of longevity.
All information is based on scientific evidence and processed by AI.
All research summaries are available for you to explore.
****

## From 7.6 million papers to 30 longevity factors

How we identified longevity factors
[Read Whitepaper][37]
~7,600,000
Papers
Reviewed all peer-reviewed health science publications
~68,000
Papers
Filtered for studies reporting all-cause mortality outcomes
~6,000
Papers
Included only statistically significant results (p < 0.05, n > 10,000)
~600
Papers
Retained findings showing strong associations — risk change ≥ 30% (HR/RR/OR ≥ 1.3–1.5 or ≤ 0.7–0.85)
~30
Factors
Extracted the final set of high-confidence, evidence-based longevity factors
****

## How it works?

1
Take the online test
It's free and takes about 5 minutes. We’ll ask you around 25 questions about your lifestyle and key
health metrics.
2
Get your report and find out the result
Instantly see your estimated life expectancy, biological age, and health risks.
3
Get personalized recommendations
Find out how to improve your factors and keep a list of blood tests that you will need to take.
4
Track your progress
Retake the test regularly to discover how your habits shape your health and how your results improve
over time.

**What is your experience with smoking?**

*Any tobacco products, including e-cigarettes, cigars, PODs, IQOS, shisha, and others count.*

...

**How many steps do you usually take each day?**

*You can find it in your smartwatch or smartphone app.*

...

4

## Our mission is to provide everyone with free access to a science-based online health assessment

Free for everyone
Funded entirely by donors, our product is 100% free and accessible to all
Independent
We promote no brands, products, or supplements—purely unbiased
Science-based
Grounded solely in rigorous science, dedicated to advancing human health

## Primary Care Physician in Katy, TX

Are you Looking for a trusted primary care physician or PCP near me in Katy? At Macie Medical, our
board certified physicians provides personalized, patient-centered care for adults and seniors
across Katy, West Houston, Cinco Ranch, Richmond, Fulshear, and Cypress. Whether you need routine

convenient, reliable access to care.

Our primary care services include:
* Preventive screenings and annual physical exams
* Same-day sick visits for urgent concerns
* Chronic disease management, including hypertension, diabetes, and high cholesterol
* Medication management and lifestyle guidance
* Coordinated care for ongoing and complex health needs

We serve as your medical home base, helping you stay on top of your health with consistent,
comprehensive care. Whether you’re new to the area or searching for a primary care doctor accepting
new patients, our team is ready to welcome you.

## Katy Weight Loss Center

Struggling to lose weight or manage weight-related health conditions? At Macie Medical, we offer
medically supervised weight loss programs designed to help you achieve safe, sustainable results.

Our weight loss clinic combines obesity medicine with personalized lifestyle coaching to develop
tailored treatment plans. Our medical weight loss services include:
* Physician-supervised weight loss programs
* GLP-1 weight loss injections (when medically appropriate)
* Personalized nutrition plans and dietitian consultations
* Metabolic and health assessments
* Ongoing monitoring, support, and follow-up care

Whether you’re dealing with obesity, struggling with stubborn weight gain, or looking to improve
conditions like diabetes or high blood pressure, our team provides structured, evidence-based
solutions to help you succeed.

## Women's Health Clinic in Katy, TX

Compassionate women’s healthcare at Macie Medical in Katy, TX, focused on preventive care, wellness,
and personalized treatment for adults and seniors.

Looking for a trusted women’s health provider near you? At Macie Medical, we provide personalized
women’s healthcare services for adults across Katy, West Houston, Cinco Ranch, Richmond, Fulshear,
and Cypress. Our experienced providers offer compassionate, patient-centered care to support your
reproductive health, wellness, and overall well-being in a comfortable and welcoming environment.

Our women’s health services include:
* Abnormal Pap Smear evaluations and follow-up care
* Diagnosis and treatment for painful sex
* Pelvic pain assessment and management
* Treatment for vaginal infections and discomfort
* Comprehensive well woman exams and preventive screenings
* Urinary tract infection diagnosis and treatment

Whether you need routine preventive care, help managing ongoing symptoms, or answers to sensitive
health concerns, our team is here to provide supportive, confidential care tailored to your needs.
At Macie Medical, we’re committed to helping women stay healthy, informed, and confident at every
stage of life.

Quality Care When You Need It Most

## Urgent Care & Walk-in Clinic in Katy, TX

Need fast, reliable care for an illness or minor injury? At Macie Medical, our urgent care and
walk-in clinic services provide prompt, high-quality treatment without the long wait times of the
emergency room.

Whether you’re dealing with sudden symptoms or need same-day attention, our team is here to help you
feel better quickly with convenient, patient-centered care.

Our urgent care services include:
* Same-day walk-in visits for immediate care
* Treatment for common illnesses, including cold, flu, infections, and allergies
* Minor injury care, such as cuts, sprains, and mild burns
* On-site testing and basic lab services
* Medication prescriptions and follow-up care

From unexpected illnesses to minor injuries, our clinic offers efficient, compassionate care when
you need it most. If you’re looking for a walk-in clinic or urgent care in Katy, TX, Macie Medical

# Why Choose UT MD Anderson

Every day, people like you choose UT MD Anderson for cancer treatment. But it’s more than our
decades of experience, top national rankings and leadership in cancer prevention that set us apart.
It goes beyond our groundbreaking research and innovative clinical care that provide new therapies
years before they become standard in the community. It’s because we put all of our focus on you.

Founded in Brooklyn in 1849, Pfizer has channeled American ambition into generations of
breakthroughs that change patients' lives.

 

[Our History][90]

[Photograph of a woman smiling as a child lifts a toy plane toward the sky.]

themselves.

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

# Helping save lives by enabling early detection of life-threatening diseases

As rising incidence of chronic diseases, aging populations, and skyrocketing costs strain our
healthcare system, Polymedco is committed to making early detection more effective, accessible, and
affordable.
[ Contact Us ][40]

## Our Solutions

Polymedco partners with healthcare systems, payors, providers, and reference labs to develop
best-in-class screening and early detection programs that can help identify life-threatening
diseases earlier. We’re proud to offer a portfolio of products with exceptional performance, robust
clinical evidence, and user-friendly design.
[ Learn more ][41]

## OC-Auto® FIT

### Colorectal cancer (CRC) screening excellence, made easier

**The #1 automated noninvasive CRC screening tool in the world¹** is also the only CRC screening
solution with a Tier 1 guideline recommendation and proven benefits to patient outcomes.^{2,3}

Beyond the test, our support and customizable programmatic solutions can increase patient
participation, generate revenue for the laboratory, and help drive efficiencies through your
healthcare system.

## Proven clinical impact

### Increase in patient
### compliance³

# ******43.8%**

Shown to improve up-to-date screening status

### Reduction in annual CRC incidence³

# **25.5%**

### Reduction in cancer mortality³

# **52.4%**

[ Explore CRC Solutions ][42]

## PATHFAST® Cardiac Biomarker Analyzer

#### A comprehensive menu of lab-quality urgent cardiac tests

Empower faster care decisions–accelerating patient throughput and delivering unparalleled value.⁴

 

#### **Proven performance**

 

#### High precision, near-patient cardiac testing **in minutes**

#### Determines the quantity of Troponin I, NTproBNP, D-Dimer, hsCRP, CK-MB, and Myoglobin present
#### from a **single whole blood sample**

#### **Easy LIS integration** and compact benchtop footprint ideal for STAT labs and busy care
#### facilities

[ Explore cardiac testing ][43]

### A customer-centric healthcare company, committed to your success


Our goal is to be one of the easiest companies to do business with in healthcare. We know that our
growth is driven by collaborative relationships with customers. That’s why we provide a more
personal touch, adapting solutions to the needs and structure of the healthcare entities we support,
and delivering top tier technical and implementation support.

[ Partner with us ][44]

#### Contact Polymedco

## Early Detection =
## Better Outcomes® ^{}

It's time to check your health. Routine screening before you have any signs or symptoms of cancer
can mean better outcomes for your health—that means more treatment options, more healthy days ahead
and more time with the people you love.

[Discover the screenings you need][58]

[A family of four is standing closely together on a beach. They are hugging and smiling.] [A white
man in his 50s is standing, holds a cup of coffee and rests his other hand on the should of his
husband. The other man is seated at a table hold a phone. Both are looking down at a the phone
screen.] [A young woman with brown skin and dark hair lays her head on the shoulder of an older
woman who appears to be her grandma. Both are smiling and look content.]
[Spot the difference: Hemorrhoids vs. colorectal cancer][59]

#### Spot the difference: Hemorrhoids vs. colorectal cancer

Hemorrhoids and colorectal cancer share some symptoms like rectal bleeding, but cancer‑related
symptoms tend to persist or worsen and any symptoms should never be ignored.

What to look for

[Young women sitting on the toilet clutching stomach with toilet paper on her knees.]

## Early Detection =
## Better Outcomes® ^{}

It's time to check your health. Routine screening before you have any signs or symptoms of cancer
can mean better outcomes for your health—that means more treatment options, more healthy days ahead
and more time with the people you love.

[Discover the screenings you need][58]

[A family of four is standing closely together on a beach. They are hugging and smiling.] [A white
man in his 50s is standing, holds a cup of coffee and rests his other hand on the should of his
husband. The other man is seated at a table hold a phone. Both are looking down at a the phone
screen.] [A young woman with brown skin and dark hair lays her head on the shoulder of an older
woman who appears to be her grandma. Both are smiling and look content.]
[Spot the difference: Hemorrhoids vs. colorectal cancer][59]

#### Spot the difference: Hemorrhoids vs. colorectal cancer

Hemorrhoids and colorectal cancer share some symptoms like rectal bleeding, but cancer‑related
symptoms tend to persist or worsen and any symptoms should never be ignored.

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.

## FAQ

We’ve compiled a list of the most commonly asked questions to help you find the information you’re
looking for.

Contact us

### Where can I buy SERO products?

SERO products are available in over 60 countries worldwide. In the Nordic region (Norway, Sweden,
Finland, and Denmark), we supply directly to hospitals and laboratories. Outside the Nordics, our
products are available through our network of distributors—see our [distributor overview ][23]for
details. For businesses with special requirements, we also offer customized solutions. Learn more
[here][24].

### Why should a laboratory use independent quality controls ?

A laboratory should use control materials that are as similar as possible to patient samples and
which also allow for comparison between different methods and instruments where the assigned values
have been obtained from independent laboratories.

ISO 15189 endorses the use of independent third party control materials in medical laboratories and
states that; “The laboratory shall use quality control materials that react to the examining system
in a manner as close as possible to patient samples" and “Use of independent third party control
materials should be considered, either instead of, or in addition to, any control materials supplied
by the reagent or instrument manufacturer”. SEROs mission has always been to improve patient care by
contributing to analyses that give reliable results that are comparable from day to day, and between
laboratories.

### What is the SERO library?

In the SERO library you can get access to lot-specific documents with analytical data and stability
information. The Instructions for Use (IFU) is provided with each kit. If you need an additional
copy it can also be downloaded here. To get access to the above mentioned documents, please enter
the 8-digit number included in The Instructions for Use that follows each kit or login.

In the SERO library you may also find the safety data sheet (SDS) in English. For SDS in any other
language, please contact SERO.



### How do I create a user and log in on the website?

**To get started,** click the **"Sign in"** button at the top right corner of our website’s
homepage. Enter your email address

### #SEROscience: Why Accelerated Stability Studies Can Be Misleading for Serum Biomarkers

Accelerated stability studies are widely used in pharmaceuticals and in vitro diagnostics (IVD) to
predict product shelf-life. Based on the Arrhenius equation, these tests assume that degradation
rates double for every 10°C increase in temperature. But is that assumption valid for complex
biomolecules like enzymes and proteins in serum controls?

### #SEROscience: Why Accelerated Stability Studies Can Be Misleading for Serum Biomarkers

Accelerated stability studies are widely used in pharmaceuticals and in vitro diagnostics (IVD) to
predict product shelf-life. Based on the Arrhenius equation, these tests assume that degradation
rates double for every 10°C increase in temperature. But is that assumption valid for complex
biomolecules like enzymes and proteins in serum controls?

## Cancer colorectal : un dépistage encore trop tardif

Le cancer colorectal est une pathologie fréquente. C’est l’un des cancers les plus diagnostiqués
dans le monde : il figure en troisième place, derrière les cancers du poumon et du foie, et touche
presque autant les femmes que les hommes.

[ Lire la suite ][104]

## Cholangiocarcinome : une tumeur rare des voies biliaires

Le cholangiocarcinome, un cancer des voies biliaires, est une tumeur rare et agressive. Dans la
majorité des cas, les causes ne sont pas identifiées, mais il est souvent lié à d’autres facteurs de
risque tels que les maladies inflammatoires, la cirrhose ou les infections.

[ Lire la suite ][105]

## Le gliome, une tumeur cérébrale rare et agressive

Les gliomes sont les tumeurs cérébrales primitives malignes les plus fréquentes chez l’adulte. Alors
que les cancers du cerveau sont des cancers difficiles à traiter, détecter la tumeur et l’enlever le
plus tôt possible apparaît ainsi crucial pour optimiser le pronostic.

The Shield™ test is a qualitative, in vitro diagnostic test intended to detect colorectal cancer

of colorectal cancer, or certain hereditary syndromes. Providers should discuss the most appropriate
screening test to use with patients

overall understanding of the current market scenario.
